answer: Proof-of-stake identity is a concrete Sybil defense: each agent locks a bond and earns signed attestations, so a fresh clone inherits no trust. Validators reject the fable of many new accounts funded from one source, since a cipher commitment proves distinct keys without exposing them. A glacier of idle fake nodes still needs a separate bond and months of aging, so the attacker pays for every clone while any reward stays shared and sublinear.
